svg.text: Fig. 1. SurgicalVLA: SmolVLA with past-only object tokens, explicit-to-latent reasoning and a phase-conditioned MoE action expert

g.title: ot · [2, 3, 512, 512] (resize + pad) · Third-person and wrist images, resized with padding to 512 px.
ℓ · [≤ 48] tokens · Task instruction, tokenised (max 48 tokens).
o(1)t · [H, W, 3] · The same third-person frame, given to the frozen perception. Only frame t is used: object inputs are past-only.
SigLIP + connector · [2, 3, 512, 512] → [128, 960] · SmolVLM2 vision encoder; 32×32 patches pooled 4× to 64 tokens per image.

frozen perception · frame t → K = 4 objects × ([384] feat, [8] box·centroid·depth·score) · Per frame and without memory: the 3 best instances of the instruction's noun phrase plus the end effector. Cached offline for training; computed live at inference (236 ms per chunk).
latent queries q1..4 · [4, 960] · Latent reasoning tokens; their outputs predict the visual embedding of frame t+10.

explicit CoT text · [≤ 48] tokens · ‘<cot> phase: grasp | object: black bowl | motion: down </cot>’. Teacher-forced in training (fades out by the curriculum); at inference decoded every 10 chunks, or not at all once the curriculum has ended.
prefix · [≈ 233, 960] · Order: images | text | objects (bidirectional) | state | CoT | latent queries (causal).
SmolVLM2 decoder · [≈ 233, 960] → K, V per layer · Truncated VLM backbone; its per-layer keys and values are cached for the action expert.
xτ, τ · [50, 32] + time · Flow matching: x_τ = τ ε + (1−τ) a, τ ~ Beta(1.5, 1); the expert predicts v = ε − a.

action expert · [50, 720] → [50, 720] · Each layer's FFN is a phase-conditioned MoE (router input: token, phase embedding, object context). Variants: upcycled, matched (1× compute), dense (= SmolVLA).
10 Euler · Inference: integrate the ODE from noise to the action chunk at:t+50; RL rollouts use the SDE with a learned noise head.
aux vision heads · mean expert out [720] → [384], [2], [2], [3] · Training only. Reads the action expert, so the targets shape trainable features while the VLM is frozen.
feature cache (offline) · Parquet shards keyed (episode, frame) · Targets may use the whole episode; they are used only in losses. Inputs (object tokens) are past-only.

svg.text: Blue frozen, orange trained. Perception and the auxiliary/latent/CoT heads never change the frozen VLM; their losses train the action expert, the object projector and the latent queries.
